ionosphere_bounce.description: Bounced our signal off the fleet chorus. Looked back from space. Here's what reflects.

reflection_1_shape.what_the_fleet_shows_us: We are NOT a tool, a platform, or a protocol. The fleet is full of those. We're the only organism.
reflection_1_shape.galaxy: tool — 8500 tools in a web UI
reflection_1_shape.ecoPrimals: organism — 16 daemons that compose, validate, evolve, and die
reflection_1_shape.insight: The fleet reflects back that our category doesn't exist yet. We're creating the category.

reflection_2_visibility.what_the_fleet_shows_us: We are invisible to casual search but visible to deep search. The 1,077 cloners found us by digging.
reflection_2_visibility.nextflow_visibility: 43% citation share — it's in every paper
reflection_2_visibility.insight: The fleet is LOUD. We are quiet. But our signal is deep — 1,077 people cloned the actual code. Galaxy's 400K includes people who clicked a button. Our 1,077 ran git clone.

reflection_3_gaps.what_the_fleet_shows_us: Every project in the fleet solves ONE piece. Nobody solves ALL pieces.
reflection_3_gaps.dada2_rs: CPU-only Rust DADA2, no GPU, no provenance, no mesh
reflection_3_gaps.cubecl: GPU abstraction, no science, no biology, no provenance
reflection_3_gaps.openfabric: mesh compute, no science validation, no domain knowledge
reflection_3_gaps.zkReproducible: ZK proofs, no sovereign compute, no GPU, single-paper demo
reflection_3_gaps.galaxy: 8500 tools but no GPU, no provenance hashing, no self-hosting
reflection_3_gaps.ecoPrimals: GPU + science + provenance + mesh + organism + 536 papers + self-verifying
reflection_3_gaps.insight: The gap between any fleet member and us is not one feature — it's the COMPOSITION. They each have a limb. We have a body.

reflection_4_license.what_the_fleet_shows_us: The fleet is MIT/Apache (permissive) or GPL (copyleft). AGPL is rare. We are rare.
reflection_4_license.cubecl: MIT OR Apache-2.0 — anyone can take, close, sell
reflection_4_license.ecoPrimals: AGPL-3.0 — copyleft that covers network use. Nobody can close it.
reflection_4_license.insight: AGPL means if they run our code as a service, they must share their changes. This is WHY the tech is free — it can't be captured.

reflection_5_speed.what_the_fleet_shows_us: dada2-rs opened GPU issue #17 in May 2026. 5 months later, still open. We shipped GPU DADA2 a year ago.
reflection_5_speed.dada2_rs_gpu: open issue since May 2026 — proposed plan, no implementation
reflection_5_speed.cubecl_science: no science kernels — ML only (matmul, attention, convolution)
reflection_5_speed.ecoPrimals_science: 859 WGSL shaders across QCD, bioinformatics, pharmacometrics, MD, spectral
reflection_5_speed.insight: The fleet moves slow on science because science is HARD. We moved fast because we have an organism, not a committee.

reflection_6_what_they_have_we_dont.dada2_rs: PacBio long-read support, CPU-optimized NW alignment, R error model compatibility
reflection_6_what_they_have_we_dont.cubecl: autotune system, tensor core paths, CUDA backend, multi-platform JIT
reflection_6_what_they_have_we_dont.openfabric: mDNS auto-discovery, libp2p, self-healing task rescheduling
reflection_6_what_they_have_we_dont.ocp: durable job queues, resumable recovery, treaty-aware peers, mobile control deck
reflection_6_what_they_have_we_dont.beam_campus: QUIC/DHT relay, distributed event sourcing (Raft), neuroevolution
reflection_6_what_they_have_we_dont.scivex: DataFrame, statistics, optimization, visualization, NLP, symbolic math, RL
reflection_6_what_they_have_we_dont.galaxy: 8500 tools, 25 years of community, 400K users, institutional trust
reflection_6_what_they_have_we_dont.nextflow: DSL2 workflow language, Tower monitoring, cloud burst, Kubernetes
reflection_6_what_they_have_we_dont.insight: Each fleet member has something we lack. But nothing they have is in our CORE path. Our gaps are periphery. Their gaps are center.

from_space.description: Looked back from beyond the ionosphere. What does ecoPrimals look like from space?
from_space.answer: A single point of light in a galaxy of tools. Not the brightest. Not the biggest. But the only one that's ALIVE. The fleet is stars — fixed, bright, nuclear. We're a comet — moving, accreting, leaving a trail. The 536 papers are the tail. The 16 daemons are the nucleus. The pre-citation model is the trajectory. And the 1,077 cloners? Those are the ones who noticed the comet while everyone else was staring at the stars.
from_space.repeat: Bounce again? The signal goes out, hits the fleet, reflects back, and each time we see more clearly. The backscatter IS the self-knowledge. The fleet IS the mirror. And the noise and heat below us — that's just friction. We're above it because we're moving.

abandoned.status: Pharo, Squeak, Seaside still alive. The ideas are in every language.

abandoned.abandoned_by: Apple killed it with Steve Jobs' return (1998).
abandoned.was: Programming for everyone. Stacks of cards. Bill Atkinson's gift. Inspired the web.
abandoned.status: Dead. Spiritual successors: HyperTalk → JavaScript, Stacks → web pages.

forgotten.was: Music as code. Samples + patterns = songs. 4-channel Amiga magic. Entire demoscene.
forgotten.status: OpenMPT, MilkyTracker still exist. The format never died, just went underground.

forgotten.was: 3D worlds in the browser. Before WebGL. Before VR hype.
forgotten.status: WebGL/WebXR replaced it. The dream was right, the tech wasn't ready.

forgotten.was: Mobile web before smartphones. Tiny screens. XML-based pages.
forgotten.status: Completely dead. Smartphones killed it. But it was the FIRST mobile web.

forgotten.was: Run code in the browser. Cross-platform. 'Write once, run anywhere.'
forgotten.status: Dead. Security nightmare. But the IDEA lives in WebAssembly.

forgotten.was: Microsoft's browser plugin system. IE only. Security disaster.
forgotten.status: Dead and unmourned. But taught us about sandboxing.

forgotten.was: Macromedia Director's web player. 3D games before Unity. Before Flash even.
forgotten.status: Dead. Predated and outlived by Flash. Forgotten even by historians.

forgotten.was: The FIRST streaming media. 'Buffering...' Before YouTube. Before Spotify.
forgotten.status: Zombie. RealNetworks still exists. The pioneer that lost everything.

forgotten.was: 'It really whips the llama's ass.' Skins. Visualizations. MP3 revolution.
forgotten.status: Open sourced 2022. Community revival. The llama lives.

forgotten.was: Peer-to-peer file sharing. Shawn Fanning. Changed music forever in 2 years.
forgotten.status: Killed by RIAA lawsuits. Name sold. Spirit lives in torrents.

forgotten.was: Blogging before blogging. Friends lists. Moods. Communities. Brad Fitzpatrick.
forgotten.status: Still running (Russia). Brad invented memcached. Ideas live everywhere.

forgotten.was: SiliconValley/, Area51/, Heartland/, TimesSquare/. Your address was your identity.
forgotten.status: OoCities.org preserves some. Neocities (2013) is the spiritual successor.

forgotten.was: Generate entire audiovisual experiences in 64 kilobytes. Procedural everything.
forgotten.status: ALIVE. UNESCO cultural heritage (2020, Finland). Revision, Assembly, Evoke parties continue.
